items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Here's the band that I was playing in. ... Johnny Kuhlman. From John Kuhlman. Oh, that's a picture. ... I think I've even seen pictures of him on the band.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's got to be him. Nobody else will that dare again. Yeah, there's Sharky. And... All right, now.
Here's the band that I was playing in. Come on, uh... Okay, we'll move all this, John.
